name: beyond-bliss-regimes-v1-addendum
frozen: 2026-11-06, after the declared regime results and before this control was computed. Post hoc.
reason: The declared rule flagged selected F2 at Bliss expectation R >= 75. Near saturation, a monotone miscalibration of the Bliss rule can look like pair-specific gain, so the gain is re-measured against a recalibrated Bliss reference.
control: calibrated_bliss: per test fold f, isotonic regression of inhibition on R fitted on the three training folds only (validation and test folds unused), applied to the test rows
analyses: interaction residual R2 of calibrated_bliss relative to Bliss, per declared regime
interaction residual R2 of selected F2 and F0 relative to calibrated_bliss, per declared regime
rule: same intervals, Holm correction and seed requirement as the declared analysis; regimes stay defined by the original R
